false_option: No — no federal student loan accrues interest while you're enrolled at least half-time

source: U.S. Department of Education, Federal Student Aid: interest accrues on Direct Unsubsidized Loans during all periods, including in school; only Direct Subsidized Loans have interest paid by the government while the borrower is enrolled at least half-time.
